title: Nepal: Constitution & Government
notes:
Constitution of Nepal 2072 (2015)

The current constitution was promulgated on 3 Asoj 2072 (20 September 2015) by the Constituent Assembly. It established Nepal as a federal democratic republican state.

Structure of the State

  • Three levels of government: Federal, Provincial (7 provinces), and Local (753 local units).
  • President is the Head of State; Prime Minister is the Head of Government (federal executive).
  • Legislature: Federal Parliament with two houses — House of Representatives (HoR) and National Assembly (NA).
  • Judiciary: Supreme Court, High Courts, District Courts.

Key Numbers

  • Provinces: 7 · Local units: 753 · Federal constituencies (HoR): 165 direct + 110 proportional.
  • National Assembly: 59 members (56 elected + 3 nominated).
